scope: Proposition 6.1 of the manuscript “Log abundance in numerical dimension one for threefolds in positive characteristic” (preprints/Log-abundance-in-numerical-dimension-one-for-threefolds-in-positive-characteristic-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 035 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 0938366c005f8930), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 12. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (X, B, N0) be the data of Proposition 2.3 in the maximal-nef-dimension case. There exist a smooth projective threefold V , a very ample divisor HV , and a nonzero effective Cartier divisor D = X α mαDα having all the properties in Theorem 2.1. In particular, its support is connected with simple normal crossings, gcdα(mα) = 1, and OD(D) is torsion.
